Audix D6 spec sheet (version 3), opened 2026-11-12 (pdftotext): dynamic cardioid, 117 mm long, 21.5 mm diameter at the base, 51 mm at the widest point (its position is not stated), 254 g, gold plated 3-pin XLR male, balanced 280 ohm output, no power requirement and unaffected by phantom power, machined aluminium body, steel wire-mesh grille. The profile between those three numbers is a drawn estimate (no drawing opened); the grille position along the body is an estimate. Generic artwork only (content/generic-panels/<id>.json, drawn by npm run asset:panel): connectors, knobs and indicators drawn at the port positions, no photo, no logo, no lettering. Every port and control position is a guess (confidence guess): no drawing or photo was opened. Connector genders not stated by the source follow the convention input = female, output = male.
